pages.text: $(thing)Sophisticated Backpacks$() and $(thing)Sophisticated Storage$() share one idea: containers you customise with upgrades. Backpacks go on your back. Storage covers chests, barrels and shulker boxes. Both use the same upgrade system.

pages.title: Backpack
pages.text: Worn on your back. Tiers climb from the basic backpack through copper, iron, gold, diamond and netherite, each with more slots and upgrade slots.

pages.title: Storage Chests
pages.text: Chests, barrels and shulker boxes come in the same material tiers. Barrels can be limited to a few stacks. Use the Storage Tool to change appearance.

pages.title: Stack Upgrade
pages.text: Multiplies how many items fit per slot. Higher tiers stack more. Conversion recipes upgrade one tier to the next.

Common upgrades:$(br)$(li)Pickup and Magnet collect items.$(li)Filter limits what goes in.$(li)Feeding eats for you.$(li)Restock and Refill keep your hotbar full.$(li)Void and Compacting tidy overflow.$(li)Smelting, crafting, jukebox and more.

pages.title: Controller
pages.text: Links many nearby Sophisticated chests and barrels into one big inventory. Add a Storage Link to connect other storage.

Both mods have Create add-ons that let backpacks and storage work on contraptions. See $(l:home/contraption_storage)Contraption Storage$(/l).$(br2)More inventory help: $(l:home/inventory_tools)Inventory Tools$(/l).
